skills.name: Decorative Wave (波綴)
skills.line: I knew life was short, but...
skills.description: One of Umi no Chou's Sea Genies jumps out from the water and attacks a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Revolving Genies (霊巡)
skills.description: At the end of Umi no Chou's turn, the Sea Genies that revolve around her attach themselves to a random non-summoned ally, sustained for 1 turn. ; : ;Sea Genie (海霊) : :'''General, Mark''': Triggers once when receiving an attack, Removed after 3 triggers. Triggers once for multiple enemy attacks in a single turn. When it's triggered, has an 80% base chance to randomly inflict the attacker with the 1 of the following effects for 1 turn: ATK is decreased by 80%, DEF is decreased by 30%, SPD is decreased by 25.

upgrades.text: '''Sea Genie''': Seal is added as a random effect.
'''Sea Genie''': Freeze is added as a random effect.
Number of allies Seal Genie can be granted to increases to 2.
'''Upper Hand''': Umi no Chou automatically starts battle with Sea Genie (sustained for 1 turn).

skills.name: Aquatic Heart (海心落)
skills.line: I'm here, I'm the only one here, the sea falls.
skills.description:
Umi no Chou focuses the power of the sea to restore the HP of 2 non-summoned allies with the lowest HP proportions by 12% of her max HP.
For each ally attached by a Sea Genie at the start of her turn, increases the restored amount by 10%.

upgrades.text: When restoring allies' HP, also restores her own HP by 16%.
When restoring allies' HP, their DEF is increased by 20% (lasts for 2 turns).

bio.condition: Increase Umi no Chou's level to 40.
Increase Umi no Chou's skills 8 times.
Collect 10 Umi no Chou shards from Demon Parade.
